name: Migration Structure & Contract Verification
details: Verified table schema, RLS policies, unique constraints (tenant_id, order_id, delivery_date), transition RPC, and non-destructive idempotent backfill.

name: Existing Orders Readability & Data Integrity
details: Audited 10 existing orders and 20 order items. 100% have valid day_date, strictly positive qty. Zero orders are in delivered state.

name: Multi-Day Fulfillment E2E Lifecycle & Isolation
details: Demostrated: Monday delivered leaves Wed/Fri in pending; orders.status remains non-final until 100% of services are resolved.

name: Packing Handoff & Active Day Operational Filtering
details: Unpacked orders in_production do NOT appear in delivery-today; packed orders appear immediately; other operational dates are strictly excluded.

name: Dietary Snapshot Immutability on Delivery Card
details: Delivery card renders frozen dietary snapshot (gluten, milk, kiwi). Changes to active customer profile do not alter historical delivery card.

name: Tenant Isolation & Partitioning
details: Services belonging to Tenant A are never returned or modified by queries scoped to Tenant B.

name: B2B Site Location Address Snapshotting
details: B2B order resolves siteAddress from company_locations into delivery_address_snapshot with exact street and site label.

name: Quality Gates & Build Validation
details: All quality gates passed: tsc --noEmit (0 errors), eslint (0 errors/warnings), vitest suite (6/6 tests), build (Nitro SSR successful).
